intro.text: A Fjordell arteth in Kae, trained as an assassin at Rathbore Monastery.

items.text: After Hrathen came back from Elantris, he summoned Dothgen before dawn, confirmed that he had trained at Rathbore, and said he had a use for those skills. Dothgen asked who the work was for, since only a gyorn or a ragnat could employ Rathbore priests without the Wyrn's leave.

appearance.text: Tall and powerfully built, his muscles straining against his Derethi robes.
